rules.clay: fill / rule / background / secondary arm only — never text or a meaningful icon stroke on light
rules.on_clay: ink for text (8.07:1); green for large text only (3.30:1)
rules.favicon: two-tone from 24px up; favicon-16.svg below that
rules.icons: aria-hidden="true" + focusable="false" — the accessible name goes on the control
